issues.description: Method 'orderMeal' has conflicting return types: the problem statement's UML declares orderMeal(Meal) as returning void (problem_statement.md line 31), while the solution implementation defines public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 12). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about the required method signature and whether they should return a boolean value, and it may cause tests or example code to be inconsistent with either the spec or the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) update the problem statement/UML to declare orderMeal(Meal): boolean and document the meaning of the boolean return value (e.g., true when order was accepted), or (B) change the solution implementation to public void orderMeal(Meal meal) and adjust its internal logic accordingly. Also ensure any tests, example calls (Main), and the template (if SealSaloon is provided there) are updated to match the chosen signature.
